source_rules.name: Active coverage
source_rules.risk: Payment for an inactive teaching policy.
source_rules.contract: An inactive policy returns decision denied and reason INACTIVE_POLICY, before any benefit or network check.

source_rules.name: Service benefit
source_rules.risk: Payment for a service missing from the chosen contract.
source_rules.contract: Use plans.json as the authoritative synthetic matrix. A known service not listed in the selected plan returns denied / SERVICE_NOT_COVERED. Part C and Medicare Advantage are the same category. These service lists are teaching fixtures, not actual coverage determinations.

source_rules.name: Network control
source_rules.contract: When network_required is true and in_network is false, return denied / OUT_OF_NETWORK. Other plans accept either network flag with identical simplified payout; real emergency exceptions and cost sharing are outside V1.

source_rules.name: Prior authorization
source_rules.risk: Approving a claim without the required teaching authorization.
source_rules.contract: If service appears in authorization_services and authorized is false, return denied / AUTH_REQUIRED. Check this after service coverage and network.

source_rules.name: Drug formulary
source_rules.risk: Accepting a prescription outside the synthetic formulary.
source_rules.contract: For a covered prescription service, formulary false returns denied / NON_FORMULARY. For other services, the flag has no effect. Check after network and authorization.

source_rules.name: Payout calculation
source_rules.risk: Overpayment, negative payout, or policy-limit bypass.
source_rules.contract: For an otherwise accepted request, payout_cents = min(max(amount_cents - deductible_cents, 0), limit_cents). Read deductible and limit from plans.json. All V1 plans deliberately use a synthetic 10000-cent deductible and 200000-cent cap per evaluation. At or below the deductible, return approved / COVERED with zero payout. This is not an annual accumulator, actual Medicare deductible, allowed-amount calculation, or real benefit payment.
